meta_reasoning.name: META-REASONING & RESEARCH STRATEGY
meta_reasoning.scope: cross-cutting analysis of all seven representations

not_implemented: Relation Instance and N-ary relation classes
Computational Experiment as a first-class node type

observer_non_privilege.name: Reality Independence
observer_non_privilege.statement: Existence and evolution of processes do not depend on being observed.

observer_non_privilege.name: Observer Non-Privilege
observer_non_privilege.statement: Human, instrument, algorithm and reference frame have no prior advantage.

observer_non_privilege.name: Observation as Physical Relation
observer_non_privilege.statement: Observation is itself an interaction/trace with conditions and possible impact.

observer_non_privilege.name: Representation Non-Identity
observer_non_privilege.statement: Map, model, image, measurement, twin are not the object itself.

observer_non_privilege.name: Perspective Invariance
observer_non_privilege.statement: Check what is preserved or lawfully transformed across perspectives.

observer_non_privilege.name: Epistemic Humility
observer_non_privilege.statement: Unknown stays unknown; absence of knowledge is not absence of phenomenon.

principles.machine_checkable_consequence: A claim asserting existence must reference source-backed evidence; grounding='graph_record' or existence=true with no sources is rejected.
principles.name: Reality Independence
principles.statement: Do not derive physical existence from the presence of a record.

principles.machine_checkable_consequence: A perspective comparison must contain >=2 perspectives, each with recorded conditions, and no unearned preferred perspective.
principles.name: Observer Non-Privilege
principles.statement: Compare admissible perspectives without auto-preferring one.

principles.machine_checkable_consequence: Observation context records conditions and impact; when impact is non-none, system-before/during/after are distinguished.
principles.name: Observation as Physical Relation
principles.statement: Observation is an interaction with conditions and possible impact.

principles.machine_checkable_consequence: Nodes carrying representation_of cannot be typed as the represented Entity/EntityState and must declare representation_non_identity.
principles.name: Representation Non-Identity
principles.statement: A representation is never the physical entity it represents.

principles.machine_checkable_consequence: Transformation set is frozen before the test; outcome is one of three explicit states; 'not detected' is never encoded as false/absent.
principles.name: Perspective Invariance
principles.statement: Preservation or lawful transformation across fixed perspectives.

principles.machine_checkable_consequence: non-fact data modes never become verified; absence-inference events are rejected; unknown is not converted to false or zero.
principles.name: Epistemic Humility
principles.statement: Our ignorance is not a property of reality.

principles.machine_checkable_consequence: System Model/Implementation/Execution/Capability/Limitation/Blind Spot stay distinct; a green test never carries physical_confirmation=True.
principles.name: Self-Application
principles.statement: Apply our own criteria to our own ontology and implementation.

principles.machine_checkable_consequence: Trace records include formation/preservation/detection/selection stages; absence of trace is never recorded as absence of phenomenon.
principles.name: Trace Survival
principles.statement: Record the filters between event and available evidence.

principles.machine_checkable_consequence: A classification change must reference a claim revision and keep the physical entity_id unchanged.
principles.name: Classification Is a Claim
principles.statement: Reclassification changes our claim, not physical identity.

principles.machine_checkable_consequence: Concept changes use one of seven typed relations and do not silently mutate Entity payloads; they record reality_changed=False by default.
principles.name: Ontology Evolution
principles.statement: Keep concept evolution separate from reality evolution.

principles.machine_checkable_consequence: Conflict propagation targets must be within disputed claims; no explosion event is allowed.
principles.name: Paraconsistent Isolation
principles.statement: One unresolved conflict must not contaminate independent branches.

principles.machine_checkable_consequence: A claim carrying valid_time must also carry transaction_time; the knowledge date is never recorded as the event date.
principles.name: Bitemporal Honesty
principles.statement: Valid Time and Transaction Time are different axes.

principles.machine_checkable_consequence: Computational experiment records code/env/deps/checksums/params/algorithm/solver/convergence/discretisation/outputs/replayable and declares its distinction from synthetic models and reconstructions.
principles.name: Computational Reproducibility
principles.statement: A computation must be replayable years later.

principles.machine_checkable_consequence: An intervention records option loss structurally (not one number) with lost future methods, irreversibility, damage and legal/cultural limits.
principles.name: Future Research Option Value
principles.statement: Preserving future research options can beat today's intervention.

principles.machine_checkable_consequence: An insufficiency event carries a declared reason, preserves raw data, forbids forced classification, and any proposed extension stays 'proposed' until separately approved.
principles.name: Ontology Insufficient
principles.statement: The system must admit its categories are inadequate.
